description:
gf2 implements codes from DVB-T2 and 5G NR. Researchers relying on them need the supported configurations, conventions and verification evidence in one place.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A page under `docs/reference/` states the supported DVB-T2 and 5G NR code configurations, the systematic encoding convention, test-vector provenance and the conformance tests that verify them, verified against current code, manifests and tests.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its prose and structure are freshly authored; reused items from `crates/gf2-coding/docs/DVB_T2.md`, `LDPC_VERIFICATION_TESTS.md` and `SYSTEMATIC_ENCODING_CONVENTION.md` are limited to verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and data.
- [hard] REQ-03: It contains no elementary primer, historical narration, migration language, speculation, future promise, marketing language or performance figure.
- [hard] REQ-04: Provenance files kept beside data (for example `crates/gf2-coding/data/ldpc/nr_5g/PROVENANCE.md`) are linked, not copied.
- [hard] REQ-05: The page is listed in `docs/index.md`, and its links, anchors and citations resolve.
title: Write the standards conformance reference page
